parameters.command: ={{ `TARGET='${$json.targetDir}'; if [ ! -d "$TARGET" ]; then echo '{"exists":false,"files":[]}'; exit 0; fi; echo '{"exists":true,"files":['; FIRST=true; for f in "$TARGET"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] || continue; NAME=$(basename "$f"); SIZE=$(stat -c%s "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo 0); if [ "$FIRST" = true ]; then FIRST=false; else echo ','; fi; echo "{\\"name\\":\\"$NAME\\",\\"size\\":$SIZE}"; done; echo ']}';` }}
